description: Re-fetch the latest valid CPFS Pro license key for an email from the CPFS license server and store it (renewal that feels like the same key got extended). The server always returns a freshly-signed key for that email; it is verified locally before storing. Default server: https://ragbox.llc.

email.description: The email used to purchase CPFS Pro.

server.description: Override license server base URL (default https://ragbox.llc).

name: cpfs_refresh_license
